dedupe_keys.name: renep national network of permanent gnss stations portugal

description: ReNEP is the Portuguese national network of permanent GNSS stations, a public geopositioning service of the Directorate-General for Territory (DGT) that maintains the national geodetic reference frame and gives GNSS users data for determining coordinates with better than 10 centimetre precision. Its continuously observing GPS/GNSS stations broadcast observations in ETRS89 on the mainland and ITRF93 in the autonomous regions, for real-time positioning with RTK and for post-processing with RINEX files, which are served from an FTP server; station coordinates are published in a PDF. Access to the real-time products requires registration, and all ReNEP products provided by DGT are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: the site is in Portuguese, and RINEX files need a dedicated FTP client. Coverage is Portugal, including the autonomous regions. It supports positioning infrastructure studies and the monitoring of space weather effects on GNSS; related records are ERGNSS of Spain and ASG-EUPOS of Poland.
